description: This file contains step definitions for behave BDD tests related to active tags, including setup, validation, and handling of inherited tags, with references to behave modules, tag matchers, and testing utilities.

classes.name: TagAndStatusStatement
classes.description: Represents a feature or scenario tag and status, used to model test elements.

classes.name: ActiveTagMatcher
classes.description: Handles matching and skipping logic for active tags based on provided values.

classes.name: NumberValueObject
classes.description: Encapsulates numeric comparison logic for tag values.

methods.name: normalize_tags
methods.description: Removes leading '@' from tags and normalizes them.

methods.name: make_model_element
methods.description: Creates a TagAndStatusStatement with specified attributes, used for modeling feature/scenario elements.

methods.name: step_given_setup_the_current_values_for_active_tags_with
methods.description: Sets up current active tag values from a table input.

methods.name: step_then_following_active_tags_combinations_are_enabled
methods.description: Validates active tag combinations against expected enabled states.

methods.name: step_then_following_active_tags_combinations_are_enabled_with_inherited_tags
methods.description: Validates active tag combinations with inherited tags against expected enabled states.

methods.name: step_unknown_categories_are_ignored_in_active_tags
methods.description: Sets context to ignore unknown categories in active tags.

methods.name: step_unknown_categories_are_not_ignored_in_active_tags
methods.description: Sets context to not ignore unknown categories in active tags.
